title: great app with a lot of features but unreliable
body:
I really wanted to love this alarm app because it comes with some amazing features. The ability to scan a barcode or solve math questions to dismiss the alarm is super effective—it actually forces me to wake up and think instead of just snoozing it half-asleep. These features really helped me form better morning habits.

However, the biggest issue is that half the time, the alarm doesn’t even ring. It only shows a notification in the notification center that the alarm is going off, but there’s no sound at all. This has caused me to oversleep multiple times, which defeats the entire purpose of an alarm app.

If the developers can fix this major bug and ensure the alarm rings every time, this would easily be a 5-star app. Until then, it’s frustrating to rely on something that’s so inconsistent.

title: A miracle. (If it works)
body:
Update 27 Dec 2018: Apparently it was claimed that sometimes ios causes Alarmy to not ring when on silent mode, despite going through all necessary failsafes. But I've noticed considerable improvements as I don't really get the below issue often anymore, so bumping up another star for this great app!

Update 15 Oct 2018: not sure whether it's ios12 or alarmy but alarm doesn't work well when phone's on silent mode. AND YES I'VE READ THE FAQS. Still a decent app except I may get woken up sometimes by notifications nowadays (disabled DND permanently as well to avoid forgetting considering I wake up at different timing sometimes.) Oh Wells 

I have been late for almost 99% of my life for anything. 

Some of them includes:  weddings(not mine, yet), exams, bday parties, even important job interviews, and even though not everything is due to me not being able to walk up, most of these things happen early in the morning. And I ABHOR sleeping early. (I average 4 hours sleep everyday for at least 2 decades already)

To make matters worse, my brain gets used to the same sound very fast, and since I'm used to snooze (trust me if I disable snooze now you might as well kill me), it gets conditioned easily to turn off the alarm subconsciously, resulting in most alarm clocks, including iPhone to be useless in a matter of months (unless I keep changing the ring tone, but meh) 

So yeah, these two combined makes it a potent life destructing poison.

The above thus makes me the most credible person to review alarmy. And I gotta say its phenomenal how no one else have ever tot of this: alarmy shines when it comes to being stubborn af. Trust me it just won't go away! I've managed to figure out certain "bypasses" but this thing WILL stay on until you are truly off your bed. I once set an alarm with take a picture to disable and accidentally activated it while I was out.

There was nothing I could do to shut it off Sans uninstalling it. And I'm glad my brain has yet to reach that level of sentience. 

Until then this thing is a gem at helping me to be less late (Yeah that's how bad it is for me). My case is serious but alarmy is truly a godsend, second only to professional help. 

10 STARS!

title: Absolutely amazing. It was so much easier waking up until...
body:
(Problem is in the 4th paragraph if you have no time reading)

I’m a student who has stained my record permanently just because I have been late THAT many times. 

After downloading Alarmy for a whole solid month I wasn’t late for anything at all, not once, and I even started to wake up at 5 instead of 6 to workout before I went to school. My life really changed and all my friends thought I’d been cursed because they were used to seeing me arrive at school when half the day is over. 

HOWEVER, after a few months for some reason the alarm seemed to be getting softer and softer. I thought it was because of Low battery mode, or maybe the fact that my phone tended to get buried in my blankets sometimes which would muffle the sound, but I remembered that previously it was way louder and those two factors did not affect it at all. 

To clarify, there is a difference between how loud the alarm rings when it first rings and after I try to dismiss it. After I try to dismiss it, the alarm then starts to ring as loud as my phone can, so there’s no issue there. My problem lies with the loudness of the alarm when it first rings, before I press dismiss. 

It’s so soft that i can’t be woken up by it at all. My entire household and my neighbours used to be woken up by this demon of an alarm but now literally no one is. It’d just keep ringing for 6 hours or so, then my phone runs out of battery. 

Is there a way for me to change this? And if there isn’t a way, would it be possible to have an option for the initial ringing to sound as loud as the ringing after trying to dismiss the alarm? Thanks!

body: I'm not often compelled to write reviews but I knew I had to for this one! I was out of bed instantly and rushing to the other size of the house to take a picture and make the alarm stop. If you struggle to get up, then this is the perfect app to overcome that struggle and get to your work. Something I really appreciate is also the variety of alarm sounds, which means that the alarm isn't blaring and doesn't wake my little sister up from her sound sleep.
